description: Inventaires de marchés publics – Port de Bruxelles is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Haven van Brussel. This dataset covers the inventory of public markets of the Port of Brussels. It complies with the specifications of the January 14, 2021 circular. The years covered by this dataset go from 2020 to the last financial year available. Coverage: Haven van Brussel. The portal shows the English title as "Inventories of public procurements - Port of Brussels" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Haven van Brussel. Its keywords include inventaire marchés publics, transportation, inventory public procurements, inventaris overheidsopdrachten. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
